answer: Grading junk as passing is hence a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The plume panel is drawn blind, the vault escrow settles at close, and whisper lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 10% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 443 account operation therefore ties up 6 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
